blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Pretrained video generation models distill internet-scale motion priors into robot policies, but full video is a redundant signal for action prediction. We argue that dense 3D motion is the medium through which video pretraining best transfers to robot actions, and that predicting motion rather than video affords better sample-efficiency for action prediction. FloMo is a 5B video-generation model fine-tuned to predict 3D scene-flow and action tokens. Rendering scene flow as RGB and encoding it into the same latent space as video enables a pretrained video generation backbone to efficiently adapt to predict 3D scene flow. Co-trained on action-free human video and action-labeled robot teleoperation data, our model benefits from human-video pretraining and generalizes to unseen objects, motion primitives, and tasks. Replacing motion prediction with a video prediction objective degrades out-of-distribution generalization, while adding a video prediction target alongside motion lowers policy success rather than improving it. When motion, video, and action are predicted jointly, action tokens attend far more to motion than to video, suggesting that predicting video wastes model capacity. Together, these results indicate that motion effectively mediates the transfer from video pretraining to action. More information can be found at flomo-wam.github.io.
blocks.zh: 训练有素的视频生成模型将互联网尺度的运动前身提炼成机器人政策,但完整的视频是动作预测的冗余信号. 我们主张,密集的3D运动是视频预先训练对机器人动作的最佳转移的媒介,而预测运动而不是视频能为动作预测提供更好的样本效率. FloMo是一个5B视频生成模型的微调,用于预测3D场景流和动作符. 将场景流作为RGB进行渲染,并将其编码为与视频相同的潜伏空间,使得预先训练的视频生成主干能够高效地适应以预测3D场景流. 我们的模型从人类影视预演中获得了好处, 以视频预测目标取代运动预测可降解分配外的泛化,同时在运动的同时增加一个视频预测目标会降低而不是改善政策成功. 当运动、视频和行动被联合预测时,动作符号比视频要多得多,这表明了预测视频废物模型的能力。 这些结果表明,运动有效地调解了从视频预训到行动的转移。 更多信息见flomo-wam.github.io。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Pretrained video generation models can be used to distill internet-scale motion priors into robot policies. Transfer from video to action is typically attributed to information overlap between RGB videos and the actions that produce them: a model that predicts the world’s next pixels has implicitly learned the dynamics that link action to outcome [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . Video, however, is a far higher-entropy signal than the action it implies. Videos that differ in texture, lighting, material, and background depict the same underlying motion and imply the same action, so a world action model (WAM) trained to predict pixels spends capacity on appearance that action prediction never uses [ 4 , 5 , 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 预先训练的视频生成模型可用于将互联网规模的运动前缀分解入机器人政策. 从视频到动作的转移通常归因于RGB视频与产生视频的动作之间的信息重叠:一个预测世界下一个像素的模型隐含地学习了将动作与结果[1,2,3]联系起来的动态. 然而,视频是一个远比它所暗示的动作更高的内涵信号. 不同纹理,照明,材料,和背景的视频描绘出相同的底部运动并暗示着相同的动作,因此一个接受过预测像素训练的世界行动模型(WAM)将能力花在了动作预测从未使用的外观上[4,5,6].

blocks.en: WAMs vary on how tightly they couple the video backbone to the action head, but they share a prediction target: future pixels. We question this assumption and ask: which prediction target lets video pretraining transfer to action most directly? We argue that the answer is 3D motion. Given the current observation, the action that produces a future state depends on how the scene transformed rather than on appearance and texture. Predicted frames that differ only in lighting or background share the same motion and imply the same action. Predicting motion rather than pixels hence targets a lower-entropy signal and incorporates this invariance instead of forcing the model to learn it, leaving the action head a tighter information bottleneck it can decode directly.
blocks.zh: WAM在如何紧密地将视频主干线与动作头对接上,但它们共享一个预测目标:未来像素. 我们质疑这个假设并问:哪个预测目标让视频预训最直接地转移到行动? 我们主张答案是3D运动. 鉴于目前的观察,产生未来状态的动作取决于场景的变相,而不是外观和纹理. 仅在照明或背景方面有差异的预测帧共享相同的运动并暗示相同的动作. 预测运动而不是像素,从而瞄准一个低等信号,并吸收了这种偏差,而不是强迫模型去学习,使动作头留下更紧的信息瓶颈,它可以直接解码.

blocks.en: Our insight is that a pretrained video VAE already provides a latent space for motion. We represent motion as the 3D displacement of each tracked scene point over time in a canonical frame independent of camera motion, otherwise known as 3D scene flow , and render this vector field as an RGB image. Rendering scene flow as RGB lets us encode it with a pretrained video VAE, giving scene-flow tokens the same latent representation format as video without needing to train a new tokenizer. This lets us finetune only the backbone to predict motion.

We co-train on action-free human video and action-labeled robot teleoperation data, and find that predicting motion alone improves both in-distribution policy success and out-of-distribution generalization, relative to predicting video or predicting video and motion jointly.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: 1. Motion as a WAM prediction target (§ III ). We argue that WAMs should predict motion rather than video: motion is a lower-complexity, texture-invariant target an action head can decode directly, and the priors of video pretraining are carried by the pretrained backbone, not by the prediction target. We realize this by rendering 3D scene flow as an RGB image and encoding it with the pretrained video VAE, so scene-flow tokens share the video latent space and a single backbone flow-matches motion and action without a new tokenizer. 2. Motion is the most effective prediction target for policy learning (§ IV-B1 , § IV-B2 ). Across real-robot manipulation, predicting motion yields higher in-distribution success and out-of-distribution generalization than predicting video or jointly predicting video and motion; adding a video target interferes with action learning rather than complementing it. 3. Generalization from human video (§ IV-C ). Our model generalizes to objects, motion primitives, and tasks seen only in human data.

blocks.en: II-A Learning Robot Policies from Action-Free Videos
blocks.zh: II-A 学习机器人政策与无行动视频

blocks.en: Action-labeled robot demonstrations are expensive, while large-scale action-free videos of humans, robots, and objects are abundant. One line of work uses passive video to pretrain visual representations, rewards, or value functions ( [ 7 ] , [ 8 ] , [ 9 ] , [ 10 ] ). These methods improve data efficiency but do not learn explicit predictive models of future dynamics.
blocks.zh: 被贴有行动标签的机器人演示费用昂贵,而人类,机器人,和物体的大规模无行动视频则相当丰富. 一行工作采用被动视频预演视觉表现,奖励,或价值功能([7],[8],[9],[10]. 这些方法提高了数据效率,但没有学习未来动态的明确预测模型.

blocks.en: Another line of work learns latent actions or transition variables from unlabeled videos through self-supervised objectives such as future prediction, frame consistency, or reconstruction ( [ 11 ] , [ 12 ] , [ 13 ] ). While these methods reduce reliance on action labels, their latents may encode visual information useful for reconstruction but unnecessary for control.
blocks.zh: 另一行工作通过自我监督的目标,如未来的预测、框架一致性或重建([11]、[12]、[13]),从无标签视频中学习潜在的行动或过渡变量。 虽然这些方法减少了对动作标签的依赖,但其潜想可能编码出对重建有用的视觉信息,但对控制来说却没有必要.

blocks.en: Finally, work on learning from human videos studies cross-embodiment alignment or explicit retargeting to transfer human demonstrations to robots ( [ 14 ] , [ 15 ] , [ 16 ] , [ 17 ] , [ 18 ] ). These works focus on bridging the human-robot embodiment gap; our work instead focuses on the prediction target inside of a WAM.
blocks.zh: 最后,从人类视频中学习的工作是研究交叉表现的对接或明确重新瞄准将人类演示转移到机器人([14], [15], [16], [17], [18]). 这些工作侧重于弥合人与机器人的相隔;我们的工作则侧重于一个WAM内部的预测目标。

blocks.en: II-B Motion and Geometry-Aware Video Prediction
blocks.zh: II-B 运动和几何-智能视频预测

blocks.en: Raw pixel prediction is an expensive and indirect objective for learning physical dynamics, motivating methods that introduce motion or geometric intermediates. Some use 2D motion as an interface between action-free video and robot actions, predicting future image-point trajectories and conditioning policies on them ( [ 4 ] , [ 5 ] ). Others use flow or motion fields as an interface linking video prediction and manipulation ( [ 19 ] , [ 6 ] , [ 20 ] , [ 21 ] ), or separate motion and temporal reasoning from appearance and camera movement in video generation ( [ 22 ] ).
blocks.zh: 原始像素预测是学习物理动力学,引入运动或几何中间体的激励方法的昂贵而间接的目标. 有些人将2D运动作为无动作视频和机器人动作的接口,预测未来图像点轨迹,并对这些动作进行调节政策([4],[5]. 其他人则使用流场或运动场作为连接视频预测和操纵的接口([19],[6],[20],[21]),或在视频生成中将运动和时间推理与外观和相机运动相分离([22]).

blocks.en: Closest to our representation choice are methods that model dynamic scenes with compact trace spaces, 3D scene flow, or point-track representations ( [ 23 ] , [ 24 ] , [ 25 ] ). These works show that 3D motion fields are a natural substrate for future dynamics prediction. Rather than building a bespoke latent space for motion, we render scene flow into a pretrained video-generation latent space.
blocks.zh: 与我们的代表选择最相近的方法是用紧凑的痕量空间,3D场景流来模拟动态场景,或者指向正轨表现([23],[24],[25]. 这些作品显示3D运动场是未来动力学预测的自然底物. 我们不但没有为运动建造一个有线潜在空间,而是将场景流入一个事先经过训练的视频生成潜在空间。

blocks.en: II-C World Action Models
blocks.zh: II-C 世界行动模式

blocks.en: Pretrained video-generation models provide motion priors for robot learning because they are trained on large-scale videos of physical interactions and object motion. Recent work uses these models for control by coupling future video prediction with action generation. One family generates task-conditioned robot videos and then recovers or co-generates actions through inverse dynamics models or latent actions ( [ 26 ] , [ 27 ] , [ 1 ] , [ 2 ] ). These approaches preserve the pretrained video model, but deployment is expensive and performance depends heavily on video fidelity. A second family avoids explicit video rollout at test time by extracting intermediate latents from a pretrained video backbone and training an action head on top ( [ 28 ] , [ 29 ] , [ 30 ] ). This reduces inference cost, but action prediction remains limited by the quality of the extracted video features.
blocks.zh: 预受训练的视频生成模型为机器人的学习提供了运动前科,因为他们接受物理相互作用和物体运动的大规模视频培训. 最近的工作通过将未来的视频预测与动作生成相配合来使用这些模型进行控制. 一个家族生成任务条件的机器人视频,然后通过反向动态模型或潜在动作来恢复或同源动作([26], [27], [1], [2]. 这些方法保留了经过预先训练的视频模型,但部署费用昂贵,性能严重依赖于视频的忠实. 第二个家庭避免在测试时明确推出视频,方法是从事先训练好的视频主干网中取出中间潜伏物,并在上方培训一个动作头([28],[29],[30]. 这降低了推论成本,但动作预测仍然受到所取取取的视频功能质量的限制.

blocks.en: More tightly coupled world action models jointly model visual features and actions with shared or entangled architectures ( [ 31 ] , [ 32 ] , [ 33 ] , [ 3 ] , [ 34 ] ). Our work studies a complementary axis: what future state should the world model predict? Instead of pixels, video latents, or action tokens, we predict 3D scene flow, discarding texture, lighting, and material details that are irrelevant for inverse dynamics.
blocks.zh: 更紧密地结合的世界行动模型联合建模视觉特征和行动与共享或缠绕的架构([31], [32], [33], [3], [34]. 我们的工作研究了一个互补轴心:世界模型今后应该预测什么状态? 而不是像素,视频潜想,或者动作符号, 我们预测3D场景流, 丢弃纹理,照明, 和与反向动态无关的材料细节。

blocks.en: III Method
blocks.zh: 页:1 方法

blocks.en: Existing WAMs predict future video jointly with actions, forcing the backbone to model details that low-level control doesn’t require. predicts 3D scene flow in place of video. We predict within the latent space of a pretrained video generator (Wan 2.2), so the model inherits large-scale video priors through its backbone. Our model is co-trained on egocentric human video and robot teleoperation, predicting both scene flow and actions from an initial observation and a language instruction. Figure 1 gives an overview of the architecture.
blocks.zh: 现有的WAM与动作共同预测未来视频, 预测取而代之的是3D场景流. 我们预测在预训视频生成器(Wan 2.2)的潜在空间内,所以该模型通过它的骨干继承了大型视频前传. 我们的模型以自我为中心的人类视频和机器人远程操作为共同训练,从初始观察和语言教学中预测场景流和动作. 图1概述了这一架构。

blocks.en: III-B 3D Scene Flow as the Video-Action Intermediate
blocks.zh: 三.B 3D 场景流动作为视频-行动中间环节

blocks.en: The action producing a future state depends on how the scene moves, not on how it looks, motivating motion rather than pixels as the prediction target. 2D optical flow captures motion but conflates camera ego-motion with task-relevant motion. We instead predict 3D scene flow in a canonical frame, which isolates the geometric transition between states while discarding appearance and camera motion.
blocks.zh: 产生未来状态的动作取决于场景的动向,而不是其外观,激发运动而不是像素作为预测目标. 2D光学流能捕捉到运动,但能将相机自负-运动与任务相干相干. 相反,我们预测3D场景在犬形框架下会流出,这隔离了状态之间的几何过渡,同时放弃了外观和相机运动.

blocks.en: Scene-flow extraction and canonical frame. We extract 3D point trajectories in an offline preprocessing step using SpatialTrackerV2 [ 35 ] , an off-the-shelf 3D point tracker. For each clip in 𝒱 \mathcal{V} and ℛ \mathcal{R} , we slide a window of T = 16 T=16 frames and place Q = 4096 Q=4096 query points on a 64 × 64 64\times 64 grid covering the first frame. The tracker back-projects these queries to 3D and propagates them across the window, yielding trajectories { 𝐩 i ​ ( u , v ) } i = 0 T − 1 \{\mathbf{p}_{i}(u,v)\}_{i=0}^{T-1} . We express every trajectory in the camera frame of the window’s first (conditioning) timestep, so the coordinate origin is the current camera’s focal point. This makes the representation invariant to camera ego-motion and yields a motion field that primarily reflects object and hand movement. Extraction runs at ≈ 2.4 {\approx}2.4 s per 16 16 -frame window on a single NVIDIA L40S GPU.
blocks.zh: 场景流取出和克尼克相框. 我们利用SpaceTrackerV2[35],即现成的3D点跟踪器,在离线预处理步骤中提取出3D点轨道. V\mathcal{V}和R\mathcal{R}中的每个片段,我们滑出一个窗口 T = 16 T = 16 帧并放置 Q = 4096 = Q 4096 查询点在覆盖第一帧的64×64 64\times 64格. 追踪器后置这些查询到 3D 并传播到窗外, 生成出 { pi (u, v) } i = 0 T = 1 \{\ mathbf{ p}_{i} (u,v) \}_{i = 0}^{T-1} 。 我们表达窗口第一个(空调)时间台阶的相机框中的每一个轨迹,因此坐标源是当前相机的焦点. 这使得表现不常被摄取自负-运动并产生一个主要反映物体和手运动的运动场. 提取器在单个NVIDIA L40S GPU上运行,每16个16个框架窗口为 2.4 \ 大约} 2.4 s.

blocks.en: Cumulative scene flow. Rather than supervising on instantaneous per-frame velocities, we predict cumulative scene flow, defined as the total 3D displacement of each point from the first frame to frame i i : 𝐅 i ​ ( u , v ) = 𝐩 i ​ ( u , v ) − 𝐩 0 ​ ( u , v ) , \mathbf{F}_{i}(u,v)\;=\;\mathbf{p}_{i}(u,v)\;-\;\mathbf{p}_{0}(u,v), (2) so 𝐅 0 = 𝟎 \mathbf{F}_{0}=\mathbf{0} by construction. We find cumulative scene flow to be a smoother target than instantaneous scene flow: it reduces the per-frame tracking noise that dominates the supervision signal, letting fine-grained motion like fingertip and object movement be predicted accurately.
blocks.zh: 累积场景流出. 我们不监督瞬间每帧速度,而是预测累积场景流量,定义为从第一帧到帧i的每个点的总3D相移: F i (u, v) = p i (u, v) – p 0 (u, v) , \ mathb{F}_{i} (u, v)\;\;\ mathb{p}_{i} (u, v)\; -\;\;\ mathb{p}_{0} (u, v), (2) 因此 F 0 = 0 mathb{F}_{0}=\- mathb{ 0}通过构建. 我们发现累积的场景流比瞬间场景流更平滑的目标:它能减少支配监督信号的每帧跟踪噪音,使像指尖和物体运动这样的精细的纹理运动得到准确的预测.

blocks.en: III-F Training Procedure
blocks.zh: 三-F 培训程序

blocks.en: We train our model in two stages using a mixture of egocentric human video and robot interaction data. Both stages use AdamW with a constant learning rate and bf16 mixed precision. Mid-training runs ≈ 14,000 {\approx}14{,}000 optimizer steps at global batch size 512 512 and learning rate 2.8 × 10 − 4 2.8\times 10^{-4} . Fine-tuning runs ≈ 1,500 {\approx}1{,}500 steps at batch size 256 256 and learning rate 5.6 × 10 − 5 5.6\times 10^{-5} .
blocks.zh: 我们使用以自我为中心的人类视频和机器人互动数据 将模型分两个阶段训练。 两个阶段都使用有恒定学习率和bf16混合精度的AdamW. 中训跑出QQ 14,000 ~ 约克 14{,}000 优化步骤 全球分批量大小 512 512 和学习率 2.8 × 10 - 4.2.8\times 10^{-4}. 微调运行于分批大小为256 256的500步和学习速度为5.6 × 10 − 5.6\times 10^{-5}.

blocks.en: Stage 1: Mid-training. We train on the full data mixture combining human video and robot interaction datasets. Human video samples are supervised on the scene-flow loss only ( λ a = 0 \lambda_{a}=0 , λ v = 0 \lambda_{v}=0 ), while robot samples are supervised on scene flow and action. Dataset-specific batch weights control the relative sampling frequency. This stage exposes the backbone to diverse egocentric motion at scale, building a strong motion prior before any action-specific finetuning.
blocks.zh: 第一阶段:中期培训。 我们把人类视频和机器人互动数据集结合起来, 进行完整的数据组合培训。 人类视频样本仅被监督于场景流量损失(QQ a = 0\lambda_{a}=0,v = 0\lambda_{v}=0),而机器人样本则被监督于场景流量和动作. 数据集特定批量权重控制了相对采样频率. 这一阶段使骨干在规模上暴露出各种自负主义运动,在任何特定行动微调之前先建立强势运动.

blocks.en: Stage 2: Fine-tuning. In a second stage, we exclusively train on robot interaction data, dropping the human video stream entirely. This sharpens action prediction without diluting the gradient signal with action-free samples, and we raise the action loss weight to λ a = 1 \lambda_{a}=1 .
blocks.zh: 第2阶段:精细调整。 在第二阶段,我们专门训练机器人交互数据, 完全放弃了人类的视频流。 这使得动作预测在不以无动作样品来淡化梯度信号的情况下更趋敏锐,我们把动作减重提升到正=1\lambda_{a}=1.

blocks.en: IV Experiments
blocks.zh: 四. 试验

blocks.en: We organize our experiments for around three questions.
blocks.zh: 我们组织我们的实验 围绕三个问题。

blocks.en: (1) Does predicting 3D motion rather than video improve policy performance? We compare FloMo with matched video-prediction variants and prior methods on in-distribution real-robot tasks, out-of-distribution real-robot tasks, and the RoboTwin benchmark (Secs. IV-B1 – IV-B3 ).
blocks.zh: (1) 预测3D运动而不是视频是否改善了政策绩效? 我们比较了FloMo与匹配的视频预测变体以及分配中真机器人任务,分配外真机器人任务和RoboTwin基准(Secs. IV-B1 – IV-B3)的先前方法.

blocks.en: (2) Does action-free human video enable out-of-distribution transfer? We remove the human-video portion of the training mixture and measure the resulting change in performance on novel objects, tasks, and motion primitives (Sec. IV-C ).
blocks.zh: (2)无动作的人类视频是否允许流出传播传输? 我们移除了训练混合物中的人-视频部分,并测量由此导致的新物体、任务和运动原始物的性能变化(第IV-C节)。

blocks.en: (3) Does motion serve an effective intermediate for action prediction? We use an inverse-dynamics probe to measure how efficiently actions can be recovered from ground-truth motion versus ground-truth video, and analyze how the action stream allocates attention across modalities (Secs. IV-D1 and IV-D2 ).
blocks.zh: (3) 运动是否为行动预测提供了有效的中间体? 我们利用反向动力探测仪衡量如何从地面-真实运动相对于地面-真实录像中高效地回收行动,并分析行动流如何分配不同模式的注意力(Sec. IV-D1和IV-D2)。

blocks.en: IV-A Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: IV-A 实验设置

blocks.en: Datasets. We train on a mixture of action-free egocentric human video and action-labeled bimanual YAM robot teleoperation. The human-video data is primarily drawn from EgoVerse [ 42 ] : 81 81 h of egocentric human video, filtered for diversity from a 1,362 1{,}362 -hour corpus. The robot component comprises 10 10 h selected for diversity from 700 700 hours of MolmoAct2-BimanualYAM teleoperation [ 43 ] , 3.7 3.7 h of internal task-directed YAM demonstrations, and 0.4 0.4 h of internal undirected YAM play. The physical YAM setup copies that of MolmoAct2. We also include 0.7 0.7 h of internal, action-free human demonstrations on tasks that overlap with robot data. Human clips provide video and scene-flow supervision. Robot demonstrations also provide action supervision. Mid-training uses the full mixture. Fine-tuning uses the in-house YAM demonstration and play data.

Baselines. We select baselines for each experiment according to each evaluation’s main question.
For in-distribution real-world evaluation, we compare FloMo with matched variants that substitute joint motion-action (MA) prediction for video-action (VA) prediction and video-motion-action (VMA) prediction to isolate whether action prediction benefits from motion, video, or both.

blocks.en: For out-of-distribution real-robot evaluation, we additionally compare against two prior works that represent close alternatives to our method: AMPLIFY [ 5 ] , which predicts sparse, tokenized 2D point tracks as an intermediate between video and action, and DreamZero [ 3 ] , which predicts future video jointly with actions. This comparison tests whether 3D motion transfers better than either image-space motion or pixel prediction under shifts in objects, tasks, and motion primitives. We train all the models on the data mixture described above until convergence.
blocks.zh: 对于分布外的真机器人评价,我们与前两部代表我们方法的相近替代的作品进行额外比较:AMPLIFY [5],它预测稀有,象征性地将2D分音轨作为视频与动作之间的中间体;DreamZero [3],它预言未来视频与动作联合. 这种比较检验了3D运动在物体、任务和运动原始物上是否比图像-空间运动或像素预测更好的转移。 我们训练所有关于上述数据混合物的模型,直到汇合。

blocks.en: On the RoboTwin [ 44 ] benchmark, we compare against 𝝅 0.5 \bm{\pi_{0.5}} [ 45 ] , FAST-WAM [ 34 ] , and an action-only Diffusion Policy [ 46 ] (Behavior Cloning) baseline. These choices represent a pretrained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policy, a video-based WAM, and a policy trained without any video pretraining. The Behavior Cloning model is a 20M parameter, 8-layer diffusion transformer with the Wan architecture. For Fast-WAM, we use the same rank-64 Wan-backbone LoRA configuration as FloMo and match the trainable capacity of its action head. We fine-tune π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} end-to-end using its native training recipe, evaluating the VLA in its standard adaptation setting. Across methods, we hold the data and evaluation protocol fixed.

blocks.en: IV-B 1 In-Distribution Real-Robot Tasks
blocks.zh: IV-B 1 实际机器人任务

blocks.en: Setup. We evaluate on three contact-rich, precision tasks on the bimanual YAM platform, modelling that from MolmoAct2 [ 43 ] . Oven requires opening a toaster-oven door, retrieving a croissant from inside, and placing it on a plate. Toolbox requires opening a hinged lid via a small crevice, grasping a screwdriver, and placing it in the container. Corn requires grasping a corn cob and placing it in a bowl. We run 15 15 rollouts per task and report success rate. We compare FloMo against the VMA and VA prediction-target variants.
blocks.zh: 设相. 我们从Molmo Act2 [43] 开始, 奥文需要打开一扇烤面包机的门,从里面取回一粒羊角面包,放入盘子上. 工具箱需要通过小接缝打开一个被锁起的盖子,抓住螺丝起子并放入容器. 玉米需要抓取一粒玉米大肠并放入一碗. 我们每个任务都进行15个15次推广并报告成功率。 我们比较了VMA和VA的预测-目标变体.

blocks.en: Results. Figure 2 reports in-distribution results. FloMo achieves the highest success rate on every task, with an average success rate of 91 % 91\% , compared with 51 % 51\% for VMA and 40 % 40\% for VA. Under the matched architecture and training protocol, adding video prediction to the motion–action objective reduces average success by 40 40 percentage-points, while replacing motion prediction with video prediction reduces it by 51 51 percentage-points. The difference is largest in Toolbox , where FloMo achieves 87 % 87\% success while both video-prediction variants achieve only 13 % 13\% . Opening the toolbox requires locating a narrow crevice and excuting contact-rich, precise motion. Predicting 3D motion directly emphasizes the geometry of this contact.
blocks.zh: 结果。 图2报告了分配结果。 FloMo在每项任务上都取得了最高的成功率,平均成功率为91% 91\%,而VMA为51% 51\%,VA为40% 40\%. 根据匹配的架构和培训协议,在运动-行动目标中增加视频预测将平均成功率降低40个百分点,而用视频预测取代了运动预测则将平均成功率降低51个百分点. 在Tolbox中差异最大, FloMo取得了87 % 87 % 成功, 而两个视频预测变量只实现了13% 13 % 。 打开工具箱需要找到一个狭小的裂缝,并执行内容丰富的精确运动. 预测3D运动会直接强调这种接触的几何.

blocks.en: IV-B 2 Out-of-Distribution Real-Robot Generalization
blocks.zh: IV-B 2 分散 实际机器人通用

blocks.en: Setup. We probe generalization along three axes, each isolating a distinct distribution shift. Close Cabinet involves pushing a cabinet door shut, an unseen motion primitive in robot data during training. Pull String requires pulling a hanging string to a target mark, an unseen task. Highlighter introduces an unseen object (highlighter) which must be placed in a bowl. We run 10 10 rollouts per condition and report success rate (SR) and task progress (TP) for FloMo, VMA, VA, AMPLIFY [ 5 ] , and DreamZero [ 3 ] . The no-human-video ablation in IV-C uses 5 5 rollouts per condition. Each task has a single intermediate stage: contacting the cabinet door for Close Cabinet , grasping the string for Pull String , and picking up the highlighter for Highlighter . TP is the fraction of these two stages a rollout completes, averaged over rollouts: 0 0 if it never reaches the intermediate stage, 50 % 50\% if it reaches it but does not finish, and 100 % 100\% if it completes the task.
blocks.zh: 设相. 我们沿着三条轴线探索一般化, 每一个轴线都隔离了独特的分布转变。 关闭的内阁包括把一个内阁门关上,一个在训练期间在机器人数据中看不见的运动原始. 拉弦需要拉出一个挂起的字符串到目标标记上,这是一项隐蔽的任务. 突出显示器引入一个必须放入碗中的隐形物体(突出显示器). 我们每个条件运行10个启动,并报告FloMo、VMA、VA、AMPLIFY[5]和DreamZero[3]任务成功率和进度(TP)。 IV-C中的无人影视放大片每个条件使用5个5个卷出. 每个任务都有一个单一的中间阶段:联系内阁门以便关闭内阁,抓住弦用于拉弦,拿起亮点用于突出显示器。 TP是这两个阶段的一小部分 推出完成,平均比推出完成: 0,如果它从未达到中间阶段,50%-50-Q,如果它到达但尚未完成,100%-100-Q,如果它完成了任务。

blocks.en: Results. Table I reports out-of-distribution results. Among the full-data methods, FloMo is the only method that generalizes consistently across all three distribution shifts. It achieves an average success rate of 60 % 60\% and average task progress of 68 % 68\% , compared with 20 % 20\% SR and 23 % 23\% TP for AMPLIFY, 20 % 20\% SR and 30 % 30\% TP for DreamZero, and 7 % 7\% SR and 15 % 15\% TP for both VMA and VA.
blocks.zh: 结果。 页:1 我报告分配外的结果。 在全数据方法中,FloMo是在所有三个分布分流中一致概括的唯一方法. 它的平均成功率为60%-60分,平均任务进度为68%-68分,相比之下,AMPLIFY的平均成功率为20%-20分,23-23分,DreamZero的平均成功率为20%-20分,30-30分,VMA和VA的平均成功率为7%-7分,15-15分。

blocks.en: All methods that predict pixels through a video objective (VMA, VA, DreamZero), or through image-space 2D tracks (AMPLIFY), degrade in performance. We hypothesize that FloMo retains performance because its 3D scene-flow representation is invariant to appearance and camera movement in pretraining and mid-training data. Removing the image-space prediction target recovers generalization, and adding the video target, even alongside motion, coincided with lower OOD success in these evaluations.
blocks.zh: 所有通过视频目标(VMA,VA,DreamZero)或通过图像-空间2D音轨(AMPLIFY)来预测像素的方法,在性能上会降解. 我们假设FloMo保留了性能,因为它的3D场景流表现在预训和中训数据中与外观和相机运动不相干. 消除图像空间预测目标可以恢复通俗化,而增加视频目标,即使是在运动的同时,也与这些评价中较低的OD成功率相吻合。

blocks.en: We attribute this gap to what each target encodes. A video objective binds the model to scene-specific appearance, texture, and object identity, none of which are preserved under the distribution shifts we test. One possible explanation is sensitivity to training-set appearance statistics. By construction, 3D scene flow discards these factors and retains only the geometric transition between states, a representation that is invariant to appearance and shared across embodiments. This is what allows FloMo to transfer a motion primitive such as string-pulling, observed only in human video, to the robot: on Pull String , FloMo succeeds on 7 / 10 7/10 rollouts while no baseline exceeds 1 / 10 1/10 .
blocks.zh: 我们把这个缺口归结为每个目标编码的内容. 一个视频目标将模型与场景特定外观,纹理,以及物体身份相接,其中没有任何一个在我们测试的发行班次下保存. 一种可能的解释是对培训设置外观统计的敏感性。 通过构建,3D场景流会丢弃这些因素,只保留了州与州之间的几何过渡,这种表现方式与外观不相干,并贯穿于各表征中. 因此,弗洛莫可以将像弦脉冲这样的原始运动,只在人类视频中观察到,转移给机器人:在拉弦上,弗洛莫在7/10 7/10推出时成功而基线不超过1/101/10.

blocks.en: IV-B 3 RoboTwin Benchmark
blocks.zh: IV-B 3 RoboTwin基准

blocks.en: Setup. We evaluate single-task adaptation on five RoboTwin tasks spanning bimanual grasping ( Pick Dual Bottles ), sequential placement ( Stack Bowls ), articulated-object manipulation ( Open Laptop ), precision placement ( Hanging Mug ), and bimanual transfer ( Handover Microphone ). For each task and method, we train a policy on the 50 50 official demonstrations. The runs use 5,000 5{,}000 gradient steps and a batch size of 256 256 . We evaluate the models on 100 100 episodes from the RoboTwin Easy setting.
blocks.zh: 设相. 我们评价五个RoboTwin任务中的单任务适应性,涉及双人抓取(Pick Dual Bottles ),相继放置(Stack Bowls ),清晰的物体操纵(Open Laptop),精密布置(Hanging Mug),和双人接取(Handover Microphone ). 对于每一项任务和方法,我们对50起官方示威活动实行政策。 运行使用5000 5{,}000梯度阶梯并分批大小为256 256. 我们从RoboTwin Easy设定的100集评价模型.

blocks.en: Results. Figure 3 (a) shows that FloMo achieves the highest success rate on all five robotwin tasks. Averaged across tasks, FloMo achieves 63.6 % 63.6\% success, compared with 44.8 % 44.8\% for π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , 41.0 % 41.0\% for FAST-WAM, and 19.2 % 19.2\% for BC. These results show that predicting 3D motion provides an effective interface for transferring video pretraining to action prediction across a distinct set of simulated tasks.
blocks.zh: 结果. 图3(a)显示,FloMo在所有五个机器人胜利任务上都取得了最高的成功率. FloMo在各项任务之间平均取得了63.6%的成绩,而FloMo在 0.5 \ pi 0.5 的成绩为44.8%,FAST-WAM为41.0%,BC为19.2%。 这些结果表明,预测3D运动提供了一个有效的界面,可以将视频预训转移到跨越一组不同模拟任务的动作预测上.

blocks.en: We verified this by direct text search of the training data. The robot data, both the MolmoAct2 episodes and the YAM demonstrations, contains no references to cabinets, strings, or markers. The EgoVerse subset, by contrast, contains all three motion classes explicitly: cabinet closing (e.g. “close cabinet door under sink”), string pulling (e.g. “pull string from spool”), and slender-object placement (e.g. “place pen lid on pen, place pen in bowl”), even though the exact word “highlighter” never appears. Since these motions are reachable only through the human video, the transfer in Table I likely originates there.
blocks.zh: 我们通过直接搜索培训数据来核实这一点。 机器人数据,即"MolmoAct2"(MolmoAct2)和"YAM"(YAM)演示,都没有提及柜子,字符串,或标记. 相形之下,EgoVerse子集明确包含所有三个运动类:柜子关闭(例如“下沉的柜子门”),取弦取出(例如“从池中取出弦来”)和放出细小的物体(例如“把笔盖放入笔上,把笔放入碗中”),尽管“更亮”的确切词从未出现。 由于这些运动只能通过人类的视频才能达到,因此表一中的转录可能源于此.

blocks.en: IV-D Analysis of Motion as an Action Intermediate
blocks.zh: 四-D 对作为中间行动的动议的分析

blocks.en: IV-D 1 Inverse-Dynamics Sample Efficiency
blocks.zh: IV-D 1 反向动态 样本效率

blocks.en: The policy results above establish motion as the more effective prediction target for WAMs, but the source of this gain remains ambiguous: it could stem from more accurate forward-dynamics predictions or a more decodable conditioning representation for inverse dynamics. We isolate the latter with a controlled inverse-dynamics probe. We repurpose FloMo to predict future action chunks from ground-truth future signals, eliminating forward-dynamics error so that any remaining difference in action error is attributable to the conditioning representation alone. We compare conditioning on ground-truth future scene flow against ground-truth future RGB, training each on { 1 % , 10 % , 100 % } \{1\%,10\%,100\%\} of a filtered subset of MolmoAct2-BimanualYAM and reporting the minimum held-out action error.
blocks.zh: 上述政策结果将运动确定为WAMs更有效的预测目标,但这一收益的来源仍然模糊不清:它可能来自更准确的前向动力学预测或反向动力学的更可解码性能表示. 我们用受控制的反动力探测器隔离后者。 我们重新使用FloMo来预测未来从地面-真实未来信号中产生的动作块,消除了前向动力学出错,这样,动作出错中的任何剩余差异都只能归因于条件表示. 我们比较了地面-真实未来场景流与地面-真实未来 RGB 的配置条件, 将每个场景的训练 {1% , 10% , 100% }\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\

blocks.en: Fig. 3 (b) demonstrates that motion is the more sample-efficient signal: at 1 % 1\% of the action data, it yields roughly 22 % 22\% lower action error than video ( 0.058 0.058 vs. 0.074 0.074 ); the gap collapses to roughly 1 % − 2 % 1\%-2\% at scales above 10 % 10\% of the dataset. Because the ground truth future is supplied in both conditions, this gap is a property of the representation quality rather than downstream performance, as in practice the actions are jointly predicted with the video or motion rather than conditioned on ground truth futures. This experiment shows, however, that motion exposes the action-relevant structure directly without losing predictive information, whereas recovering it from raw RGB video takes more examples. Motion is thus both an easier target to predict and the more efficient representation of the information needed to predict actions.
blocks.zh: 图3(b)显示,运动是比较高效的信号:在1%的动作数据中,它比视频(0.0580.058对0.0740.074)产生大约22%的22分动作出错;在10%以上的数据集中,差距下降到大约1%-2% 1分-2分; 由于地面真实未来在两种条件下都提供,因此这一缺口是表现质量的财产,而不是下游表现,因为实际上,行动是与视频或运动共同预测的,而不是以地面真实未来为条件. 然而,这一实验表明,运动直接暴露出与动作相关的结构而不丢失预测信息,而从原始的RGB视频中取回它则取出更多实例. 因此,动议既是比较容易预测的目标,也是更有效地反映预测行动所需的信息。

blocks.en: IV-D 2 Action Attention Across Modalities
blocks.zh: 四-D 2 不同方式的行动关注

blocks.en:
To compare the importance of each modality for action prediction, we investigate the attention maps of the VMA variant.
We hypothesize that if motion is an effective intermediate in our evaluated setting, then action tokens should attend predominantly to motion tokens rather than video tokens, and this pattern should persist across embodiments.
blocks.zh:
为了比较每一种动作预测方式的重要性,我们调查了VMA变体的注意力图.
我们假设,如果运动在我们评价的环境下是有效的中间体,那么动作符号应主要用于运动符号,而不是录像符号,这种模式应贯穿于各种表现形式。

blocks.en: Figure 4 reports the share of action-query attention going to each input modality (image, video, motion) as a function of DiT layer, aggregated across attention heads, averaged over 1,000 1,000 held-out samples. Beginning from an approximately uniform distribution at the input layer, action queries progressively reallocate attention toward motion tokens through the network trunk, reaching ∼ 55 % {\sim}55\% at the late-middle layers. Attention to video exhibits the opposite trend, remaining the lowest across all layers and declining to ∼ 10 % {\sim}10\% at the deepest layers. Averaged over attention heads and layers, action queries attend to motion approximately 3 × 3\times more than to video. Taken together, these results indicate that the action stream draws predominantly on motion rather than video, supporting our hypothesis that 3D scene flow is an effective intermediate in our evaluated setting.
blocks.zh: 图4显示,作为DiT层的一个功能,对每种输入方式(图像、视频、运动)的动作-静态注意所占的份额,在各注意力头之间汇总,平均超过1,000个搁置样本。 从输入层的大致统一分布开始,动作询问通过网络干线逐渐将注意力重新分配给运动符,在中后期层达到~55%~55. 对录像的注意呈现出相反的趋势, 仍然是各层最低的, 平均在关注头和层次上,动作询问处理动作的时间比视频多出大约3×3相。 这些结果表明, 动作流主要来自运动而不是视频, 支持我们的假设,

blocks.en: V Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 五. 讨论和限制

blocks.en: We argue that the priors of video pretraining are carried by a model’s weights, not by what it is trained to predict. A world action model should target motion rather than pixels: an appearance-invariant geometric signal that an action head can decode directly. Rendering 3D scene flow into the latent space of a pretrained video generator lets a single backbone predict motion and action without a new tokenizer, inheriting internet-scale video priors through its weights. Across real-robot manipulation, predicting motion outperforms predicting video and jointly predicting video and motion, both in distribution and on unseen objects, motion primitives, and tasks; action queries attend far more to motion than to video; and a controlled inverse-dynamics probe shows motion is the more sample-efficient conditioning signal. These results point to motion as an effective intermediate in our evaluated setting.
blocks.zh: 我们提出,视频预训的前科是由模型的分量承担的,而不是由它经过的预测。 一个世界动作模型应该瞄准运动而不是像素:一个外观变化多的几何信号,一个动作头可以直接解码. 将3D场景流入预先训练的视频生成器的潜在空间,让单个主干能预测运动和行动,而无需新的显示器,通过它的分量继承了互联网规模的视频前传. 通过真实机器人的操纵,预测运动的超能性能,预测视频和联合预测视频和运动,无论是在发行还是在看不见的物体,运动原始物和任务上;动作查询比视频更能进行运动;受控制的反动力探测器显示运动是更高效的样本调节信号. 这些结果表明,在我们评估的环境下,运动是有效的中间体。

blocks.en: Two limitations temper these results. First, extracting 3D scene flow adds an offline preprocessing step for every clip. Second, FloMo predicts motion and action jointly, and although the two usually agree, they sometimes diverge. A plausible predicted motion does not guarantee a correct action, because the action head is not constrained to be exactly consistent with the predicted flow, and distinct actions can in principle produce the same scene motion. In these cases, treating predicted motion as a proxy for the executed action breaks down, and tightening the coupling between the two predictions through mechanisms such as per-modality variance schedules or objectives to maximize mutual information between modalities is a natural direction for future work. Three additional failure modes occur: scene flow is predicted for the front camera only, so motion estimates degrade when the manipulated object is occluded in that view; instruction grounding is less reliable when a named object is unfamiliar or a similar distractor is present; and on occlusion-heavy clips the off-the-shelf tracker yields noisy trajectories that enter training as degraded targets.
blocks.zh: 有两个限制因素可以抑制这些结果。 首先,取出3D场景流会为每个片段增加一个离线预处理步骤. 其次,FloMo会共同预测运动和行动,虽然两者通常都同意,但有时会有所分歧. 可能预想的运动并不能保证正确的动作,因为动作头并没有被限制与所预想的流量完全一致,不同的动作原则上可以产生相同的场景运动. 在这些情况下,将预测的运动作为已执行行动的代名词处理就破裂了,通过按模式计算的差异时间表或目标等机制,加紧两个预测之间的结合,以最大限度地扩大模式之间的相互信息,是今后工作的自然方向。 出现了三种额外的故障模式:仅为前相机预测出场景流量,因此当被操纵物体被该观点所占据时,运动估计会退化;当一个被命名物体不熟悉或者存在相类似的分心器时,指示地平线就不那么可靠;在被隔离-重力夹上,现成的跟踪器产生作为被退化目标进入训练的噪音轨迹.

blocks.en: In-house YAM. Teleoperated bimanual-YAM demonstrations of three tasks: put the corn in the bowl, open the oven and place the croissant on the plate, and open the toolbox and place the screwdriver inside. Each task includes randomized initial states as well as active data collection to enable data-efficient recovery from failure modes. This subset consists of 1,029 1{,}029 demonstrations totaling ≈ 3.7 {\approx}3.7 h. Before training, data containing motion above or below pre-defined thresholds is filtered out.
blocks.zh: 内部YAM. Teleopered Bimmanual-YAM演示出三项任务:将玉米放入碗中,打开烤箱并放入羊角面包板上,打开工具箱并放入螺丝刀入内. 每项任务包括随机化的初始状态以及积极的数据收集,以便能从故障模式中高效地恢复数据。 这个子集由1,029 1{,}029个示威组成,总计为  3.7 ~ 大约}3.7 h. 在训练前,含有高于或低于预定阈值的运动的数据被过滤出.

blocks.en: In-house Human Data. Action-free human videos of the In-house YAM tasks, recorded from a single front-facing camera without action labels, so they supervise only the video and scene-flow heads. They cover the three robot tasks plus related variations (asparagus or pepper placed in a bowl or oven, pliers into the toolbox), for 710 710 demonstrations ( ≈ 0.7 {\approx}0.7 h) across 12 12 splits.
blocks.zh: 内部人文数据. 内部YAM任务中无动作的人类视频,从一个没有动作标签的单相机上录制,因此他们只监督视频和场景流头. 它们涵盖三个机器人任务并加上相关的变体(放入碗或烤箱中的橡皮或胡椒,放入工具箱中的钳子),在12个分出处共进行710个710个演示(QQ 0.7 ~ 约 0.7 h).
